facts.text: Robin van Poelje is the founder of Total Specific Solutions and served as CEO of TSS from January 2010 to 2020.
facts.source_title: Robin van Poelje named as Chief Executive Officer of Topicus.com.

facts.text: Robin van Poelje, Board Chairman, was appointed CEO of Topicus.com in November 2021, replacing Daan Dijkhuizen who focused on Constellation Software's VMS Ventures fund.
facts.source_title: Robin van Poelje named as Chief Executive Officer of Topicus.com.

facts.text: Daan Dijkhuizen has been at Topicus since 2013 and was previously a technology executive at the ING Group.
facts.source_title: Daan Dijkhuizen - Managing Partner @ Constellation VMS Ventures - Crunchbase Person Profile

facts.text: In May 2023, Bernard Anzarouth, Jeff Bender, Jamal Baksh, Mark Leonard, Daan Dijkhuizen, Han Knooren and Paul Noordeman did not stand for re-election to the board.
facts.source_title: Robin van Poelje named as Chief Executive Officer of Topicus.com.

facts.text: John Billowits, Jane Holden, Alex Macdonald, Donna Parr and Robin van Poelje were re-elected to the board in May 2023.
facts.source_title: Topicus.com Inc. Announces Re-Election of Members of the Board of Directors

facts.text: Topicus operates through three operating groups: TSS Blue, TSS Public, and Topicus Operating Group, serving over 100,000 customers in 40 vertical markets across 26 countries.
Topicus.com completed the acquisition of 72.68% of Sygnity S.A. in Poland for approximately PLN 197 million through a public tender in March 2022.
facts.source_title: Topicus.com's subsidiary Total Specific Solutions (TSS) acquires a majority share of Sygnity S.A. in Poland - Topicus.com

facts.text: Topicus.com and Constellation Software entered a shareholders agreement with the Adam Góral Family Foundation on February 3, 2025, and completed acquisition of 14.84% of treasury shares in Asseco Poland S.A.
facts.source_title: Topicus.com Inc. completes Agreement to acquire 14.84% of Treasury Shares in the capital of Asseco Poland S.A.

facts.text: Constellation's super voting share entitles it to 50.1% of aggregate votes on all Topicus outstanding shares, granting significant voting control despite lower economic ownership.
facts.source_title: Constellation Software Inc. Completes Spin-Out of Topicus.com Inc. - Topicus.com
